notes: Searches: all 6 used. Fetches: 48. Eventeny search returned no pages. Grail Card Promotions (NC): the Future Shows/Vendor Sign-Ups page (grailcardpromotions.com/event-list) rendered no event content on three reads, so the organizer's event-details pages (found through its event-pages sitemap) and its /events page are the source. They agree on all 12 listed events. Each date was checked against the Time and Location block with its year, and weekdays match. Grail publishes no table prices or organizer email (contact is via Facebook and Instagram, recorded as links, not fetched). The vendor sign-up URL is the organizer's own Future Shows page label, which did not render content. Past editions have no status field because none of the four status values fits a show that already ran. Village Inn Card Show I: the title says $3 admission or two for $5 but the body says $5, so no admission is recorded. Boone Mall: title says 110 tables, URL slug says 75, recorded as 110 at medium confidence. Inside Pitch Promotions (NC, insidepitchpromo.com): 2026 dates and table counts were checked verbatim against the page, and the 2026 year comes from the page's '2026 Sports Card and Toy Shows' heading. The 2027 dates come from the page's '2027 SHOW DATES' heading, were checked verbatim, and all fall on the expected weekend days. The 2027 rows are marked WAITLIST, and the page gives no admission, hours or table counts for them. Conflicts: the Jan 3 and 4 Raleigh show is 450 plus on the organizer page but 500 on a calendar listing, so the organizer figure is used. A CardShopFinder listing (aggregator) puts the Nov 7 Raleigh show at the Kerr Scott Building, but the organizer page says Exposition Center, NC State Fairgrounds, which is used. The organizer map links for some shows point to the Kerr Scott Building, so no street addresses are recorded for the Inside Pitch venues. Organizer contact email insidepitchpromotions@gmail.com was confirmed on two reads of the organizer's own page and is recorded as vendor contact on upcoming and 2027 rows. The 2026 vendor waitlist page returned 404, so 2026 vendor status is unknown. CCS Card Show V (Charlie's Collectibles Show): listed on happeningnext.com (medium, not an organizer page). The vendor sign-up link on that listing is a shortened URL and is not recorded. The listing gives an address but no venue name. Searched but not recorded: past Georgia and South Carolina shows with no size on any page read (Atlanta Card Fest Oct 16 to 18, 2026; Trading Post Show Oct 10, 2026; Commerce card show Oct 10 to 11, 2026; House Patrick TCG Expo Aug 1 to 2, 2026; and several others). Not covered by searches: Greensboro, Winston-Salem, Asheville, Wilmington, and most of South Carolina beyond the Simpsonville, Beaufort, Spartanburg and Charleston leads. Front Row Atlanta and Georgia Collectible Shows were excluded per the brief. Known shows MagicCon Atlanta 2026 had no new information found.
